product_value: Knowledge/QA operators and enterprise integrators can distinguish a low business proxy from unavailable or clock-invalid statistics, with real rule-engine checks required by CI.
selected_problem: Raw avg(chat_containment_rate)<0.7 treats initial zeros and retained/frozen snapshots as current evidence, causing false low-containment alerts and masking valid low-rate replicas.

contract.scope: Only job=rag-chatbot-api; match validity by(job,instance) before job-level aggregation. Same-job replicas must share data source and stats window; this is not tenant or arbitrary cluster isolation.
contract.valid_snapshot: up=1, served>=0, rate within[0,1], success timestamp>0, future offset<=60 seconds and age<=900 seconds. Missing/NaN/out-of-range/stale values do not qualify.
contract.low_containment: Mean of valid nonempty replica snapshots below0.7 continuously for30m, warning. It remains no-ticket/no-window-downvote containment, not resolution or a verified SLO. One session can satisfy the current sample rule.
contract.unavailable: A job continuously has at least one discovered invalid target, or no target up series, for10m, warning. Bad replica identity may rotate without resetting job timer; fresh zero traffic is valid. Healthy siblings do not hide bad ones.
contract.clock_skew: Maximum successful-scrape future offset over60s, warning immediately; keep_firing_for10m from the first nonmatching evaluation. This catches brief repeated skew that would reset other pending timers. Held firing does not prove current skew.
contract.clock_boundary: Exactly60s is accepted;61s is rejected and independently signaled. Match at0m, first nonmatch1m stays firing at10m and clears11m.
contract.cadence: Default refresh300s (sleep first), freshness900s, unavailable grace10m. These are static policy defaults, not automatically derived from app settings; changing cadence requires coordinated rules/fixtures updates.
contract.disabled_bridge: Refresh interval0 intentionally disables the task but leaves the KPI unavailable. The availability warning is not by itself proof of DB or chat outage.
contract.not_atomic: Replicas refresh independently and can still represent different valid instants. No sum of duplicated DB populations or atomic report snapshot is claimed.
contract.copy_correction: HandoffShareHigh now describes per-turn layer-touch traffic/routing trends; its ratio is not the session containment inverse or proof of unresolved demand.

native_validation.engine: Official Prometheus promtool2.47.2, matching Compose deployment version; isolated Darwin arm64 CLI.
native_validation.expected_states: Handwritten synthetic input snapshots and expected states/labels; no copied production expression or Python PromQL emulator. Static shared annotations only avoid text repetition.

coverage.business_duration: Default fresh0+60xn first becomes valid at1m:30m not yet firing,31m firing. A timestamp60seconds ahead is valid at0m and low rate fires exactly30m.
coverage.availability_duration: Never-initialized snapshots and missing discovery:9m quiet,10m firing. Default successful refresh at5m stays quiet; recovery clears/restarts the10m timer.
coverage.freshness: Constant TS60:at16m age900 is eligible; first ineligible minute is17m, unavailable does not fire at26m and fires at27m. Fixture uses1m rule evaluations; it does not claim a901-second freshness-evaluation test.
coverage.clock_tolerance: Exactly60s ahead valid/no clock warning;61s ahead invalid and immediate clock warning.
coverage.periodic_clock_offsets: Five-second application lead with300s refresh preserves30m quality pending. Seventy-second lead periodically resets eligibility but triggers clock warning immediately, kept across repeated observations.
coverage.keep_firing_for: Clock match at0m, first nonmatching evaluation1m:still firing10m, cleared11m. Warning starts from the expression match and retention starts at the first nonmatch, matching the final annotation.
coverage.target_down: Retained future timestamp on an already down target cannot start clock warning; prior observed clock warning retains10m after the target goes down.
coverage.replica_timer: Replica A invalid then recovers as B becomes invalid at5m:the job remains continuously unavailable and fires10m; a bad-replica identity switch does not reset the job timer.
coverage.job_and_instance_scope: Other jobs and other instance metric series cannot satisfy API validity. Multiple invalid replicas produce one job alert; healthy replicas do not hide invalid siblings.
coverage.rate_populations: Fresh empty windows are available but excluded from low-rate evidence. Fresh shared-DB replica rates are averaged as snapshots, not summed as independent populations. Existing containment/resolution formulas are unchanged.
